name: ga4
description: GA4 reports, traffic sources, landing pages, events, funnels, annotations and realtime. Read-only; run ga4_oauth_start after install to authorise.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.title: Google OAuth client ID
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Desktop-app OAuth client from console.cloud.google.com. Shared with the gsc plugin.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Google OAuth client secret
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret of the same OAuth client.

GA4_PROPERTY_ID.title: Default property ID
GA4_PROPERTY_ID.description: Numeric GA4 property id (not the G-XXXXXXX measurement ID) — see ga4_list_properties.
